items.candidate: Valid group-sequential evaluation stopping with practical margins.
items.scope: 206 VLMs/31 multimodal benchmarks; sample-level sequential assumptions.
items.result: ~15/30/50% samples for ±3/±2/±1.5pp widths; sequential resolves 76% vs 55% at fixed 1.2K.

items.scope: AgentSuite committed trajectories and audit-filter splits.
items.result: Same stored trajectories produce multiple ranking reversals after validity filtering.
items.uncertainty: Filtering does not prove every removed task invalid.

items.candidate: Message-role/authority representation as controlled self-correction factor.
items.scope: 13 model-domain cells, 7 model families, 3 domains, n=30 paired tasks/cell.
items.uncertainty: Explicit correction is not guaranteed final-answer improvement.

items.scope: Valid e-CIs/e-processes; 263 Twitter A/B experiments plus K≤1000 simulations.
items.result: At δ=.1 e-BY ships 127 vs 122 BY; common shipped experiments decide in 1.2 vs 1.5 days.

items.scope: Finite-design simulation ranking/selection with common random numbers.

items.candidate: Changepoint detection plus context-aligned evidence reuse with conservative fallback.
items.result: Main numerical instance retains ε-optimal identification at ≤1% naive-baseline sample complexity.

items.candidate: Trigger verification on decision/rank instability while preserving search depth.
items.scope: 30 noisy COCO functions×15 instances plus 6 external tasks under fixed budgets.
items.result: Probe-and-Switch wins 85.6% vs k=10 resampling, 79.3% vs k=5, 77.4% vs UH-CMA-ES; instability probe beats variance trigger 39/54 (p=.0007).
items.uncertainty: Black-box objective noise is not semantic judge bias; extreme noise can remain uninformative.

items.candidate: Anytime-valid paired acceptor for repeated self-modification.
items.scope: Qwen2.5 prompt self-evolution on GSM8K, SVAMP, ARC-Challenge.
items.result: Greedy commits 30–42% false and 10–33% harmful edits; null has 13–21 spurious edits/run with 72–100% false commits; PACE essentially avoids them at ~18% lower evaluation cost.
items.uncertainty: Per-decision guarantee, not lineage-wide FWER under endogenous edits.
